left_anchor_secondary.role: the sealed dual-store anchor; sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored

left_base.role: cell B0, the review-loop-off base this cell extends; sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored

claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows. No superiority, generalization, component-causal or confirmatory claim; nothing about Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split.

resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed

verdict.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta against cell B0 is greater than 0, pooled SLU is non-inferior within 1.18 pp (its own-null half-width), the symmetric-normalised scorer agrees in sign, and no scenario loses intent beyond the null band.
verdict.HARMFUL: the CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta is at or below -1.18 pp, or of the intent delta at or below -0.92 pp, or a scenario loses intent beyond the null band.
verdict.NEUTRAL: neither gate is breached but the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta is not above 0. The module enters the default plan only if it lowers cost; it does not here, so NEUTRAL means not adopted.

decision_rule.why_intent_is_primary: FIX-1 and FIX-2 are candidate-coverage fixes: their whole reach is the 34 rows whose gold intent is general_quirky and never appears among the candidates, plus the 11 rows delivered as qa_* under gold general_quirky. Pooled SLU can only move through the intent that selects the slot contract, so intent is the estimand this cell is powered for and pooled SLU is the guard.

delta_convention: delta = cell B4a minus cell B0, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: general scenario intent accuracy against the A3 baseline of 36.7 %
candidate coverage with and without the appended fallback (A3 baseline 86.8 %; general scenario 43 %)
the number of rows on which the fallback was appended, and the share of those on which general_quirky was then delivered
the gold general_quirky -> qa_* confusion count against the A3 baseline of 11, and the reverse direction, which was zero

estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise

metrics.estimand: per-row mean of joint scenario+action correctness

roster_metadata.carries: sample_id -> scenario, speaker, headset, utterance_id; no text, transcript or gold filler
roster_metadata.speaker_key: spk:<usrid> from the governed SLURP release metadata

resampling.seed_advance: paired_contrast advances the seed by the metric index; pooled metrics use the base seed
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed, each scenario resampled to its own size

scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer
scorer.symmetric_normalised_companion: the symmetric-normalised projection is reported beside the official number and must agree in sign for an ADMITTED verdict

tables_required: headline: cell B0, arm, delta, speaker CI95, speaker CI90, scenario-stratified CI90, equal-scenario delta, and the anchor column as a secondary reference
saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p for every per-row metric
per-scenario table, all 18 scenarios, natural mixture and equal weighting
cost table: contacts, contacts per row, repeated speech seconds, FIT endpoints, GPU hours from the serving monitor, mean latency, duty cycle, prompt-token delta
title: SLURP TRAIN A: cell B4a versus the sealed cell B0 review-off base
